newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to firm, outlook unclear.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to firm, outlook unclear.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to firmer on Friday, although weaker crude futures could pressurise prices next week.
Gasoline was stable. Eurograde barges traded between $221 and $222.25 fb ARA. MTBE traded at $285 fob ARA.
Naphtha was stable. Physical prices were pegged around $210 cif NWE.
Gas oil was firm with strong German demand and relatively tight supply supporting premiums.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded up to $119 fob ARA before easing back slightly. -- London +44 171 542 8980
